== Purpose ==
One open case shown large on [[Help Complete the Archive]]. To rotate it, edit the parameters of <code><nowiki>{{Featured mystery}}</nowiki></code> on the hub; when the case is answered, move it to [[Template:Recently solved]] and the Solved section of [[Mysteries]], with the answer and who supplied it.

== Parameters ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Meaning
|-
| <code>image</code> || File name without <code>File:</code>. A crop that shows one person or one object works best.
|-
| <code>size</code> || Image width, default 220px.
|-
| <code>question</code> || The question, in large type.
|-
| <code>clues</code> || What is known so far: where the image comes from, what the person wears, who stands nearby, and links to the list or entry the case sits on.
|-
| <code>answer_at</code> || Where to answer. Default: the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 General board] of the [https://swccg.com/forum/ SWCCG Forum], or [[Talk:Help Complete the Archive]].
|}

Choose only real open cases that are already on [[Unidentified event photographs]], [[Unknown players]] or [[Mysteries]].
